glosses: An incompetent or physically uncoordinated person; a spazmo.

examples.text: In fact, it was the view of the scientists now in charge […] that the freakier they were, the better; if a mental spaz could go through and come out all right […] then the process was probably safe for the executives, politicians, and fashion models of the world.
“I was so in control from tee to green, the best I’ve played for years… But as soon as I got on the green I was a spaz.”

glosses: A person with spastic paralysis, spastic cerebral palsy or epilepsy
To have a tantrum or fit.
To malfunction, go on the fritz.

examples.text: “A scumbag,” Sonny repeated. “Rubber. A pro-phy-natic. You know what I mean, don't you?”

glosses: A sleazy, disreputable or despicable person; a lowlife.

examples.text: Can you believe that scumbag Steve asked to sleep with her before even asking her name?
Monroney was variously described as a "scumbag," "SOB," "Snake," "dead sheep," [...] and assorted unprintable adjectives.
